// lint-expect: 1
// lint-as: internal/gateway/bff.go
// The v1 identity forward: the raw body streamed upstream with no cap.

package gateway

func (c *identityClient) forward(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, target string) {
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(r.Context(), r.Method, target, r.Body)
	_, _ = req, err
}
